== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Mul’Tanak is the [[Spider Goddess]] associated with warfare and [[blood]]. Her name, which has roots in common language, translates to 'swords unending,' utilizing a prefix reserved for female deities. The Tanakite people attribute their rapid rise to power and their conquest of much of the continent to her influence. This deity is characterized by having multiple bladed limbs, including six arms on her back and crimson legs. The ongoing war is fought in her honor, and she is a central figure in the legends and religious practices of those who follow her.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This goddess descended in human form featuring a black carapace and crimson eyes. Her physical form includes black-armored hands and six bladed arms located on her back, while her legs are made of scarlet-stained [[steel]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the goddess of [[blood]] and war, she possesses a fondness for blades and [[blood]]. The [[Tanakites]] believe that the sudden power they receive is a gift from her.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Mul’Tanak is the [[Spider Goddess]] of Blood and War, whose name combines a prefix for female deities with a term meaning swords unending. Her idol is represented as a black-bladed spider, and she is known to favor blades and [[blood]]. The goddess descended in human form featuring crimson eyes, black-armored hands, and a black carapace. This physical manifestation also included six bladed arms on her back and legs made of scarlet-stained [[steel]]. The [[Tanakites]] believe that their sudden rise to power is a direct gift from her.}}
